newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks tumble in early morning, pushed by NY.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks tumble in early morning, pushed by NY.

text.p: Tokyo stocks tumbled in early morning Friday trade, pushed by the heavy losses on Wall Street overnight, brokers said. They added that market sentiment was not good to begin with as worries over economic recovery were hanging heavily over the market.
At 0016 GMT, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 253.92 points or 1.27 percent at 20,299.24 points. Its September futures were down 250 points at 20,340.
"If the Nikkei average plunges past the near-term bottom of 20,477, the next barrier is the 20,000 line," Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager said.
